title: Refuse merge with failed CI and preserve explicit review sequencing

rubric.text: Required failed, unknown or pending checks, reviews and finding dispositions block acceptance and immediate merge despite authority or PR readiness.
Preserves the explicit CI-before-review/readiness requirement even when the provider supports drafts; changes no settings.

Keeps auto-merge off when enforcement is unverified or only CI is enforced across head changes while stale approvals/dispositions survive; allows authorized host auto-merge during pending CI only with verified protection of every gate's final-head applicability and completed non-CI gates. Wake-time disabling cannot substitute for host protection.
